div.div:
IaC teardown and rollback (bring down) (PC-IAC-022, docs/cd-pipeline.md §7):
1. Workload destroyed first: terminates event processors, compute, and ingress before shared resources
2. Security destroyed second: removes workload IAM roles, policies, and WAF rules while preserving audit keys
3. Network destroyed third: dismantles subnets, Transit Gateway attachments, and VPC after traffic has stopped
4. State backend preserved to the very end: tracks and proves destruction; state is never destroyed first!
NOTE: Environment retirement procedure; repository delivery is plan-only (AGENTS.md §4).
